# Synthetic vehicle image prompts

These three images were generated with the built-in image-generation tool on 2026-09-01. They depict fictional vehicles and events. No people, injuries, readable plates, VINs, brands, logos, or real claim information were requested.

## Naomi Carter rear-end case

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: synthetic motor-vehicle collision evidence photo for a legal software demo
Primary request: create a realistic smartphone photograph of a fictional white midsize sedan after a moderate rear-end collision
Scene/backdrop: vehicle safely parked at a generic suburban curb in Northern California, dry pavement, no distinctive landmarks
Subject: rear-left three-quarter view showing a dented rear bumper, slightly buckled trunk lid, and cracked left tail lamp; damage is moderate and mechanically plausible
Style/medium: natural unedited smartphone documentary photography, believable materials and panel deformation
Composition/framing: horizontal landscape photo, entire damaged rear half visible, eye-level standing viewpoint
Lighting/mood: neutral late-afternoon daylight, factual evidence-documentation mood
Constraints: no people, no injuries, no blood, no emergency response, no visible VIN, no readable license plate, no logos, no brands, no readable text, no watermark; the person and events are wholly fictional
Avoid: cinematic effects, dramatic fire or smoke, impossible damage, duplicated vehicle parts, showroom polish
```
